necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for an underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other conduction abnormalities contributing to these symptoms (R42). This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of evaluating conduction abnormalities, contradicting the denial based on Reason Code PR-204.
